model.name: OSB HH2 point neuron tuned to Allen Cell Types specimen 477127614 (HH2_477127614)
model.citation: Repository CITATION.md: Sadeh S, Silver RA, Mrsic-Flogel TD, Muir DR (2017). Assessing the Role of Inhibition in Stabilizing Neocortical Networks Requires Large-Scale Perturbation of the Inhibitory Population. Journal of Neuroscience 37(49):12050-12067. doi:10.1523/JNEUROSCI.0963-17.2017. The cell was tuned by OSB to Allen Cell Types Database data (cells/HH2/README.md); the Na channel file cites Pospischil et al. 2008 (doi:10.1007/s00422-008-0263-8). No publication describes this tuned cell itself.
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment (d 30 um). Leak 0.104 (erev -71.3 mV), Kd 20.97, IM 0.0166, IL (L-type Ca, fixed erev 58.7 mV) 0.421 mS/cm2, Na 59.7 mS/cm2 with vShift +1.80 mV (channelDensityVShift); Cm 4.27 uF/cm2. Tuning metadata in the cell notes (not an OMV reference): no spikes at 10-60 pA; 5 spikes at 70 pA (first at 429.6 ms, 6.0 Hz); 48 spikes at 170 pA; -90 pA reaches -101.8 mV. Harness steps start at 270 ms and last past the 1000 ms end. Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: MIT, single compartment, data-tuned rheobase near 60-70 pA with a steep f-I relation; the 7-current harness is already an f-I protocol. Caveats: only a validation OMV test (no spike-time reference); not a published model; Pospischil-derived channel kinetics, so correlated with the existing pospischil2008 family (group with it, or keep as its own family knowingly); Allen data terms may apply to the tuning data (the AllenInstituteNeuroML LICENSE carves out Allen-reused material, the MultiscaleISN LICENSE does not).
